yards_per_touch.expr: (COALESCE(TRY_CAST(rushing_yards AS DOUBLE),0)+COALESCE(TRY_CAST(receiving_yards AS DOUBLE),0))/(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(carries AS DOUBLE),0)+COALESCE(TRY_CAST(receptions AS DOUBLE),0))

passing_adjusted_yards_per_attempt.expr: (TRY_CAST(passing_yards AS DOUBLE) + 20*TRY_CAST(passing_tds AS DOUBLE) - 45*TRY_CAST(passing_interceptions AS DOUBLE))/TRY_CAST(attempts AS DOUBLE)

passing_net_yards_per_attempt.expr: (TRY_CAST(passing_yards AS DOUBLE) - COALESCE(TRY_CAST(sack_yards_lost AS DOUBLE),0))/(TRY_CAST(attempts AS DOUBLE) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(sacks_suffered AS DOUBLE),0))

passing_adjusted_net_yards_per_attempt.expr: (TRY_CAST(passing_yards AS DOUBLE) + 20*TRY_CAST(passing_tds AS DOUBLE) - 45*TRY_CAST(passing_interceptions AS DOUBLE) - COALESCE(TRY_CAST(sack_yards_lost AS DOUBLE),0))/(TRY_CAST(attempts AS DOUBLE) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(sacks_suffered AS DOUBLE),0))

passer_rating.expr:
(
  LEAST(GREATEST((TRY_CAST(completions AS DOUBLE)/TRY_CAST(attempts AS DOUBLE) - 0.3) * 5, 0), 2.375)
+ LEAST(GREATEST((TRY_CAST(passing_yards AS DOUBLE)/TRY_CAST(attempts AS DOUBLE) - 3) * 0.25, 0), 2.375)
+ LEAST(GREATEST((TRY_CAST(passing_tds AS DOUBLE)/TRY_CAST(attempts AS DOUBLE)) * 20, 0), 2.375)
+ LEAST(GREATEST(2.375 - (TRY_CAST(passing_interceptions AS DOUBLE)/TRY_CAST(attempts AS DOUBLE)) * 25, 0), 2.375)
) / 6 * 100

bonus_pass_400yd.expr: CASE WHEN (TRY_CAST(passing_yards AS DOUBLE)) >= 400 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END

bonus_rec_100yd.expr: CASE WHEN (TRY_CAST(receiving_yards AS DOUBLE)) >= 100 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END

bonus_rec_200yd.expr: CASE WHEN (TRY_CAST(receiving_yards AS DOUBLE)) >= 200 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END

bonus_pass_25cmp.expr: CASE WHEN (TRY_CAST(completions AS DOUBLE)) >= 25 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END

bonus_rush_20att.expr: CASE WHEN (TRY_CAST(carries AS DOUBLE)) >= 20 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END

bonus_rec_10rec.expr: CASE WHEN (TRY_CAST(receptions AS DOUBLE)) >= 10 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END

bonus_pass_300yd.expr: CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(passing_yards AS DOUBLE) >= 300 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END

scrimmage_tds.expr: COALESCE(TRY_CAST(rushing_tds AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(receiving_tds AS DOUBLE), 0)
scrimmage_tds.guard: CASE WHEN rushing_tds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN receiving_tds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
scrimmage_tds.license_basis: rushing + receiving touchdowns; guard = at least one component present (no components -> stays NULL, never 0)

total_tds_scored.expr: COALESCE(TRY_CAST(rushing_tds AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(receiving_tds AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(kickoff_return_tds AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(punt_return_tds AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(def_int_ret_td AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(fum_ret_td AS DOUBLE), 0)
total_tds_scored.guard: CASE WHEN rushing_tds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN receiving_tds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN kickoff_return_tds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN punt_return_tds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN def_int_ret_td IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN fum_ret_td IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
total_tds_scored.license_basis: ALL touchdowns SCORED (scrimmage + returns + defensive returns) -- measured 0.99987 before recompute; guard = at least one component present (no components -> stays NULL, never 0)

total_tds_accounted_for.expr: COALESCE(TRY_CAST(rushing_tds AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(receiving_tds AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(passing_tds AS DOUBLE), 0)
total_tds_accounted_for.guard: CASE WHEN rushing_tds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN receiving_tds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN passing_tds IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
total_tds_accounted_for.license_basis: touchdowns ACCOUNTED FOR (scored scrimmage + thrown) -- measured 0.9999 before recompute; guard = at least one component present (no components -> stays NULL, never 0)

storage_convention_law: Declared per column from LOCK evidence, never inferred: passer_rating locks compare at 0.001 against witnesses that print one decimal, so the plane stores ROUND(formula, 1). Columns absent a declaration store full precision (their locks carry the 0.05 rate floor). 2026-08-03: majority-vote detection judged the mixed-convention plane 'full' and un-rounded the witnessed minority -- the gate refused at 0.096/0.14 and caught it.
